verdict.rationale: llamafile docs confirm a built-in local HTTP server with API and Web UI options (llamafile-docs-9) and instructions to connect to localhost:8080 (llamafile-docs-5), showing it can serve a loaded model over HTTP. However, none of the evidence explicitly states the API is OpenAI-compatible or documents endpoint compatibility (e.g., /v1/chat/completions), so the specific claim in the story is only inferred, not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OpenAI-API compatibility/endpoints, and independent confirmation that the server can be used as a drop-in OpenAI API replacement.
